description: React component for managing Bluetooth devices, including listing, pairing, and removal of devices, within a web application's frontend.

methods.name: DevicesPage
methods.description: React component that displays user's Bluetooth devices and provides functionality to add or remove devices.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of devices from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handlePair
methods.description: Handles the form submission to coinpair a new device, updating state and server.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes a device both from the server and updates local state.
